To detect subtle AI artifacts in the complex refraction and iridescence patterns, which are common failure points for generative models.
To verify the optical distortion (refraction) of the background is physically consistent with a spherical lens/bubble.
To ensure the edge of the bubble is sharp and continuous without melting into the background or showing halo artifacts.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the refraction of the background elements through the bubble. AI often fails to invert or distort the background correctly according to spherical optics. Also, check if the iridescent colors follow the natural flow of gravity/thickness variation in a soap film (thicker at bottom, thinner at top) or if they look randomly painted.
